data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017, net ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2015 & prior) reduced by GBP 10.1m. This was mainly due to favourable claims experience in Director and Officers, Marine Liability and Marine Cargo resulting in reserve releases in line with standard actuarial techniques. This was offset by net ultimate claims increases in International Construction (adverse attritional and large loss development on Starr coverholder business), Professional Indemnity (large losses reported in the year; Appleby, Shepherd Building Group, Precision and Pitcher Partners) and General Liability (adverse attritional development).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 recorded a small net prior-year reserve release in 2017. Using the gross claims development triangle the gross prior-year reserves released by approximately GBP 6.7m (about 1.3% of the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 506.8m). The release was driven by favourable prior-year development in Directors & Officers and Marine (Liability and Cargo) but was partly offset by adverse development in International Construction, Professional Indemnity (notably a number of large named losses) and General Liability.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2016 comparative column). Prior-year gross movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 39) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2015; that calculation yields approximately a GBP 6.661m gross release. The report text quotes a net prior-year reduction of GBP 10.1m (net of reinsurance). Where LOB mapping was ambiguous (e.g. 'International Construction') an approximate mapping was used. Some verbatim phrases were transcribed from scanned images and may contain minor OCR variances.
